'''Switts''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Drift Hills Imperial Outpost]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He recruited an Imperial hero to retrieve a lockbox with valuable intel from a wreckage of a Republic shuttle downed by the [[White Maw]] pirates.
